g.data-exception-reason: Index1.2mm graphic line dots retain every actual end, corner, native curve extremum and projected junction. Closed0/L shares one circle and cyclic intervals count. Ordinary6.1mm protected spokes with balanced interior intervals; global3.1mm centre guard/max6.2mm native steps checked, no tangent-prefix or geometry-dropping waiver. Local fixed-span insertion bound is not global phase optimality. Pole bands and genuine coordinate/radius reference lines are separate semantic conventions, not Braille or standalone point glyphs.

use.data-subject-role: Plain bar-magnet component boundary, not a full single-magnet field lesson. Pole territories are semantic, not physical cut seams.
